edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 25,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds within 30 calendar days after execution of this Agreement by both parties, pursuant to wire instructions separately provided and independently verified.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 25,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds within 30 calendar days after execution of this Agreement by both parties, pursuant to wire instructions separately provided and independently verified. 2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims asserted, or that could have been asserted, arising from the dispute described in the Recitals. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party compelled to disclose shall provide reasonable advance notice to the other party. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
